name: Ink Wash
tagline: A slow shan-shui landscape in graded ink on rice paper, with a rising moon, drifting mist and a vertical title with a red seal.
description: Calm Chinese ink-wash look for festivals, poetry, tea and craft brands, travel and mood pieces: graded ink on warm rice paper with ink-bleed stippling, drifting mist, tiny parallax, a vertical serif title with a small red seal, and captions that dissolve in softly. Nothing snaps. The preview paints a mountain landscape with a rising moon, a plum branch, birds and a boat.

display.usage: Vertical title (writing-mode: vertical-rl) 104px, letter-spacing 0.22em; seal characters 25px; Chinese captions 38px, tracking 0.32em

body.usage: Italic English subtitle line 30px under each Chinese caption

transitions: layers fade up from the paper with sine.inOut, far → near, 0.3s apart
captions dissolve through blur(6px), never slide more than 10px
textAnimations: title characters resolve one by one from blur(10px), 1.3s each, 0.25s stagger
seal fades in from scale 1.12 with power2.out over 1s
Chinese line then English line fade up 10px from blur(6px), 0.35s apart

rhythm.notes: A single long take. Something new appears roughly every second (ridges, branch, title, seal, caption, birds), and the parallax drift and moonrise never stop.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Ground is warm rice paper (#f3eddd → #d9cfb6 radial) with a multiply fibre noise (feTurbulence baseFrequency "0.012 0.35") and a faint vignette. Ink tones only, plus one red #b23a2c for a seal and small accents.
- Paint the subject in graded ink like shan-shui: 2–3 depth layers, far #8fa2aa with a heavy 3.5px blur, mid #4f5d60, near #141614, each filled with a vertical gradient that fades to transparent, with an feTurbulence alpha stipple plus displacement (scale ≈22) for ink bleed on the near layers.
- Put blurred mist bands between layers and let them drift; depth comes from small linear parallax (far −40px, mid −90px, near −150px over the piece) and a 5% sine.inOut camera push.
- Add 2–3 quiet living details that suit the subject, drawn with dashoffset brush strokes (a branch inking itself in, a few V-shaped birds flapping with finite repeats, something drifting slowly).
- Type: a short vertical title of 3–4 characters or words (Noto Serif SC 700 ~104px, or Cormorant Garamond for Latin) in the right third, resolving character by character from blur(10px), with a 64px red seal below. Captions fade up 10px from blur(6px): Cormorant Garamond italic ~30px.
- One continuous shot. Layers fade up from the paper far → near, 0.3s apart. Use only sine.inOut, power2.out or linear, 1s or longer.
- Avoid hard cuts, bounce, scale pops, saturated colour and digital gradients.
example: The preview is a slow mountain landscape with a rising moon, mist, a plum branch, birds and a small boat, and a vertical Chinese title with a red seal. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
